name: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B · Shared lora library + CivitAI + scene continuation + identity lock + generate audio
description: Image to video, shared lora library, HF or CivitAI

paragraphs: Turn a still image into smooth cinematic motion, with your own adapters, and without guessing what a run will cost.

A shared lora library, and one link per adapter. A Wan adapter is two files, one for each expert, which normally means finding and pasting two links. Here you paste the model page address once — straight out of the address bar — and both halves are found for you, whether the author shipped them as two files of one version or as two versions of one model. A download link or a plain owner/repo works the same way. The entry is saved into a storage bucket with its name, trigger words and a strength for each half, in two lists, ordinary and nsfw, and it is still there after the Space sleeps and…

Your own lora, from anywhere. Five slots that take a Hugging Face repo, a file inside one, or a CivitAI download link pasted into the High or Low box — Wan adapters ship their two halves as separate files, so each slot has one box for each. Downloads are cached, and CivitAI's domains are tried in turn, because one of them will sometimes answer a datacentre address with a Cloudflare challenge while another does not. A gated model needs CIVITAITOKEN under Settings → Variables and secrets: the Space downloads on its own machine, so being signed in to CivitAI in a browser does not authenticate it.
